bodyHtml:
Context

A structured eco-development approach

Decathlon wanted to define concrete eco-development plans to design lighter, more efficient and sustainable digital services.

Expected results for teams: optimized technical mastery and validation of their approach through an independent external audit.

Results

Measurable benefits for all

For customers: fluid and battery-efficient applications, accessible even on old devices or with limited connections.

For Decathlon teams: precise knowledge of audited applications' impacts, based on real measurements.

For the environment: reduced carbon footprint and limited consumption of networks and servers.

Success keys

Success factors

  • A structured pilot phase with clear deadlines and objectives
  • A rigorous technical approach, with a targeted measurement strategy and tests on representative devices
  • An automation plan and CI/CD measurements integrated into the development process
  • Strong collaborative dynamics, with active team participation in upskilling their peers
  • The designation of eco-development champions to ensure the sustainability of the approach

Testimonials

What they say

"With its measurements on real devices, Greenspector provides a serious solution that meets our high quality standards for our digital products."

Nathalie OTTE, Decathlon Green IT Leader

"Greenspector Studio allowed us to understand application bugs that were reported on the Play Store but that we couldn't reproduce."

Ludovic ROLAND, Engineering Manager, Decathlon Shopping App
